topic: The Barber Pole Effect: Polarized Light and Optically Active Sugar Molecules

sections.title: Prerequisite: Polarization and the Malus's Law
lecture_lines: Light oscillates in a single plane.
animations: Draw horizontal polarized light wave (#FFFFFF) moving left to right. Change line 1 to #00FF00.
Introduce vertical polarizer, light intensity reduced by factor. Place [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/lightbulb.svg] to represent the light source. Change line 2 to #00FF00.
Demonstrate Malus's law formula: I = I0 * cos^2(theta). Change line 3 to #00FF00.

sections.title: The Concept of Optical Activity
lecture_lines: Sugar molecules are chiral and asymmetric.
They force light into spiral paths.
This action rotates the light's plane.
animations: Show light [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/light.svg] wave interacting with chiral molecule [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/molecule.svg] sample [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/sample.svg]. Change line 1 to #00FF00.
Visualize wave plane rotating by angle alpha. Change line 2 to #00FF00.
Label rotation angle alpha clearly in #FFD700. Change line 3 to #00FF00.

sections.title: The Barber Pole Effect Mechanism
lecture_lines: Different colors rotate at different angles.
Crossed polarizers reveal these color shifts.
This creates the barber pole effect.
animations: Display polarized light passing through multiple thin layers. Change line 1 to #00FF00. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/barberpole.svg]
Each layer shifts light plane by small angle delta. Change line 2 to #00FF00.
Show aggregate effect as a spiral path. Change line 3 to #00FF00. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/barberpole.svg]

sections.title: Mathematical Visualization: The Rotation Vector
lecture_lines: Rotation depends on concentration and length.
Changing concentration shifts the output vector.
The graph visualizes this precise shift.
animations: Represent light rotation as vector rotating in circle using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/light.svg]. Change line 1 to #00FF00.

Label rotation vector v with color #00FFFF and display [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/light.svg]. Change line 3 to #00FF00.
